5d562f79968c8a2d.description: Job description Job Title: Chief Specialist, Smart & Efficient Manager and Productive & Safe Worker Reporting To: Director, Technology Development Business Unit / Function: Technology & Innovation Department: Technology Enablement Grade: M13 Why This Role Matters The Chief Specialist, Smart & Efficient Manager and Productive & Safe Worker shapes how technology enables Ma’aden’s managers and frontline workforce to work more effectively, make better decisions and operate safely. The role provides enterprise technical leadership across two connected domains, translating workforce and operational challenges into scalable technology-enabled solutions. The role creates value by simplifying work, reducing inefficiencies, improving access to timely information and using digital, automation and data capabilities to strengthen workforce productivity and safety. It connects people, process, technology and operational requirements so that solutions address real business needs and can be embedded into day-to-day ways of working. As an enterprise domain authority, the role aligns Operations, HSE, HR, Engineering and Technology teams around shared outcomes, accelerating solutions that improve workforce effectiveness while maintaining safety and operational discipline. What You Will Deliver Workforce Productivity & Manager Effectiveness Shape enterprise strategies and roadmaps for the Smart & Efficient Manager and Productive & Safe Worker domains, aligned with operational priorities and Technology & Innovation objectives. Identify and prioritize opportunities to simplify work, remove process inefficiencies and improve manager and frontline workforce effectiveness. Establish clear value drivers and performance measures that connect technology-enabled interventions to productivity, efficiency and workforce outcomes. Safe & Effective Work Embed safety and risk considerations into the design of workforce technology and operational improvement initiatives. Enable technology solutions that strengthen safe work practices, workforce awareness and risk-based decision-making. Integrate productivity and safety requirements so improvements in workforce efficiency reinforce, rather than compromise, safe operations. Integrated Technology Solutions Translate manager and frontline workforce needs into integrated solutions spanning people, process, data and technology. Shape scalable solutions using relevant digital, automation, analytics and AI capabilities to improve decisions and execution. Ensure solutions are practical for operational environments and designed for effective adoption, integration and scale. Data, Performance & Value Use workforce, operational and safety insights to identify performance gaps and prioritize high-value improvement opportunities. Establish outcome measures, dashboards and value-tracking approaches that demonstrate whether interventions deliver their intended impact. Use performance evidence and user feedback to refine initiatives, improve adoption and strengthen sustained value realization. Enterprise Integration & Capability Align Operations, HSE, HR, Engineering and Technology stakeholders around shared priorities, solution requirements and measurable outcomes. Provide enterprise technical guidance on workforce productivity, manager effectiveness and technology-enabled safe work. Build organizational capability through knowledge transfer, reusable solutions and adoption of proven practices across appropriate operations. What Success Looks Like Managers and frontline workers spend less time on avoidable, inefficient or fragmented activities and more time on value-adding work. Technology-enabled interventions deliver measurable improvements in workforce productivity, operational efficiency or decision effectiveness. Workforce solutions strengthen safe work and risk awareness while meeting operational requirements. High-value solutions achieve sustained adoption and can be replicated or scaled across applicable operations. Managers and frontline teams have improved access to relevant information and insights for timely decision-making. Business, HSE, HR and Technology stakeholders align around common workforce outcomes, priorities and value measures. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management or a related discipline. Experience 15+ years of relevant experience across operations, operational transformation, productivity improvement, safety or technology-enabled business improvement. Significant experience in industrial, mining or comparable asset-intensive operating environments. Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale transformation, operational excellence or workforce improvement initiatives. Experience applying digital, data, automation or continuous-improvement approaches to workforce productivity or safety challenges. Skills That Matter Workforce productivity and operational excellence Manager and frontline work optimization Safety and operational risk integration Digital, automation and AI-enabled improvement Data-driven performance and value realization Integrated solution design and deployment Continuous improvement and process optimization Enterprise stakeholder influence Change, adoption and capability building Cross-functional integration and facilitation Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

5d5f7036b0ce8102.description: Job description The Engineer I/II (Maritime Technology) performs engineering design review and analysis assignments normally involving a major project or several smaller, less complex projects with technology and innovation focus. These projects, by nature of their complexity and difficulty, require the fully competent application of conventional knowledge in a particular field of engineering or science. Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the incumbent will develop a thorough understanding of policies, methods, and procedures. Performs work that involves conventional engineering practices but may include moderately complex problems such as the resolution of conflicting design requirements, material standards or coordination of activities among other disciplines. Drafts technically accurate and timely reports, and responses to client letters, faxes, and other forms of communication for review by an experienced engineer or engineering manager. Prepares accurate and timely weekly reports and billing on all work performed. Communicates the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure the needs of the clients will be met. May propose technical advice to field operations and other technical offices. May propose new approaches to problems encountered and make recommendations for changes in methods, procedures, or designs. Experienced Engineer from Industry A or B: A. Hull: Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software. Exposed to Finite Element Method (coursework or supervised research). Seven (7) years or more of related engineering experience in a shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or a classification society or Professional or chartered engineer license and four (4) years or more of related engineering experience in a shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or classification society. B. The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills). Background knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, digitalization, robotics, and data analytics, with an interest in evaluating and reviewing their applications in the maritime industry. 5db0ed22d6f5f6c2.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a PPC Specialist based in Saudi Arabia. Join a dynamic digital marketing environment where data-driven strategies and creative thinking come together to deliver measurable business growth. As a PPC Specialist, you will manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across search engines and social media platforms to drive qualified traffic, generate leads, and increase conversions. You will take ownership of campaign planning, execution, performance analysis, and budget management while continuously improving return on investment. Working closely with performance marketers, content creators, analytics specialists, and web teams, you will help align paid media initiatives with broader marketing objectives. Your expertise in analytics, testing, and conversion rate optimization will support smarter decisions and sustainable campaign performance. This remote, full-time opportunity offers an environment where experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning are encouraged. You will have the opportunity to shape campaign strategies, identify new growth opportunities, and make a tangible impact on digital marketing results. Accountabilities As a PPC Specialist, you will oversee the end-to-end management of paid media campaigns, combining strategic planning, hands-on execution, and performance optimization to achieve marketing and business goals. Campaign strategy and planning: Define campaign objectives, KPIs, audience targeting, budget allocations, and bidding strategies. Conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Campaign setup and execution: Build, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and relevant social media platforms, including search, display, shopping, and remarketing campaigns. Ad creation and testing: Develop compelling ad copy, organize campaign structures, and test different creative variations, extensions, audiences, and messaging to improve engagement and conversion rates. Performance monitoring and optimization: Track key metrics such as click-through rate (CTR), cost per click (CPC), cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), impressions, and conversions. Adjust bids, budgets, and targeting based on performance insights. Conversion rate optimization: Collaborate with content, design, and development teams to improve landing pages, forms, messaging, and user journeys. Use analytics and behavioral insights to identify opportunities for higher conversion rates. Tracking and analytics: Implement and maintain accurate conversion tracking, UTM parameters, advertising pixels, Google Analytics, and tag management systems to ensure reliable measurement and reporting. Reporting and insights: Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports, analyze attribution and funnel performance, and present actionable recommendations to relevant stakeholders. Budget management and forecasting: Monitor advertising spend, maintain budget pacing, and forecast traffic, leads, conversions, and ROI using historical data and market trends. Cross-functional collaboration: Share performance insights and best practices across marketing channels, ensuring paid media activities align with SEO, content, and broader digital marketing initiatives. Continuous improvement: Stay informed about advertising platform updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies. Test new channels, formats, tools, and automation opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and scalability. Requirements We are looking for an analytical, proactive, and results-oriented digital marketing professional with hands-on PPC experience, strong technical knowledge, and the ability to translate campaign data into effective optimization strategies. A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 3 years of hands-on experience managing PPC and paid media campaigns. Strong working knowledge of Google Ads, including search, display, and remarketing campaigns. Experience with Google Analytics, tag management systems, conversion tracking, and campaign measurement. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and make evidence-based decisions. Excellent written communication and ad-copywriting skills, with an understanding of how messaging influences engagement and conversions. Familiarity with landing page optimization, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, prioritize competing tasks, and meet deadlines. Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and present insights to stakeholders. Curiosity and adaptability, with a commitment to continuous learning and staying current with digital advertising developments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, or other paid media platforms. Familiarity with e-commerce and shopping campaigns. Experience with tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, WordStream, Optimizely, or Unbounce. Exposure to automated bidding strategies, advertising scripts, or API-based campaign management. Knowledge of attribution models, multi-touch attribution, and advanced marketing analytics. Google Ads and/or Google Analytics certifications. Benefits 100% remote work: Work from anywhere, subject to the role's location requirements. Competitive salary: Receive a competitive compensation package. Inclusive work environment: Join a supportive workplace that values diverse perspectives and collaboration. Career growth opportunities: Develop your expertise and progress professionally within digital marketing. Professional development: Expand your knowledge of advertising platforms, analytics, and performance optimization. Collaborative team culture: Work alongside professionals across performance marketing, content, analytics, and other digital functions. Full-time opportunity: Enjoy a dedicated role with opportunities to contribute to ongoing marketing initiatives and long-term growth. 5d3ea9f3a3abcf5e.description: About Gathern and the Role Gathern, a Saudi alternative accommodation marketplace connecting guests and hosts in line with Vision 2030, is seeking an Analytics Manager. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this full-time Analytics Manager position at Gathern in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

5d92ded36517094e.description: About Sanabil Studio and A27 Sanabil Studio is a venture builder focused on transforming ideas into businesses through industry expertise, technology, and startup methodologies. It supports ventures from conception to launch, providing seed funding and operational assistance for scaling. A27, a venture within Sanabil Studio, is developing infrastructure for structured finance, aiming to enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and speed of the end-to-end asset lifecycle in private capital markets for both borrowers and lenders. A27 integrates AI, financial infrastructure, and domain expertise to innovate private capital markets, with plans to expand into real-world asset tokenization. The venture has confirmed market demand and is now progressing into its next growth phase. The Opportunity: Co-Founder & CTO, A27 Sanabil Studio is seeking a Co-Founder & CTO for A27 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This contract role requires over 10 years of experience. The Co-Founder & CTO will be responsible for A27's technology and engineering, from early product development to establishing a scalable and secure platform. This involves building the necessary systems and leading the team to enhance the speed, accuracy, and efficiency of the asset lifecycle in private capital markets. Key Responsibilities Define and manage the architecture and engineering roadmap from initial product stages through to scale, ensuring system security, reliability, and maintainability. Lead the development of AI-enabled products that convert complex, unstructured financial data into structured, actionable intelligence. Establish and operate a modern data platform for the ingestion, processing, structuring, serving, and monitoring of financial data. Implement a responsible AI framework, addressing accuracy, model monitoring, explainability, and human-in-the-loop review for critical processes. Develop integration layers for financial institutions, market participants, and third-party data providers. Set technical standards for code quality, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and documentation. Build robust security, privacy, and data governance foundations to meet enterprise requirements and future regulatory and licensing needs. Make pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions for infrastructure, data providers, and core components. Prepare for real-world asset tokenization by assessing blockchain, custody, and smart-contract architectures required for a compliant tokenization layer as the product evolves. Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing engineering and data team in Riyadh. Collaborate with the CEO, customers, and compliance teams to translate financial workflows into product features. Candidate Profile and Requirements Demonstrated experience in shipping AI/ML or data-intensive products into production environments. Strong software engineering fundamentals combined with practical experience in AI, data platforms, or information processing. Experience in fintech, financial services, capital markets, or other regulated, correctness-critical domains, with an understanding of the importance of accuracy and auditability. Proven ability to transform complex, unstructured data into structured, reliable tools with measurable business impact. Track record of hiring, mentoring, and leading engineering teams in dynamic and ambiguous settings. Commitment to ownership of outcomes and maintaining high standards for reliability, security, and scalable architecture. Clear communication skills for engaging with engineers, executives, and non-technical stakeholders. Based in Riyadh or willing to relocate, as this is an on-site leadership position. The position offers direct collaboration with the CEO and the Sanabil Studio founding team in Riyadh, ensuring rapid feedback and direct influence on company direction. 5da6b637ddb333db.description: About Red Sea Global Red Sea Global (RSG) is a purpose-driven developer focused on positively shaping the places people live, work, and travel. The company's programs contribute to achieving Vision 2030 and advancing regenerative tourism globally. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Role Summary The Assistant Manager Digital Forensics and Incident Response will manage and oversee RSG's Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) function. This includes incident triage, containment, recovery, digital forensic investigations, malware and artifact analysis, threat hunting, and post-incident reporting across RSG's corporate, cloud, and operational technology environments. The role ensures security incidents are detected, investigated, and resolved within agreed service levels, with evidence preserved in a defensible manner, and DFIR practices aligned with RSG's organizational strategy, risk appetite, and applicable national and international standards. Key Responsibilities Manage the configuration, tuning, and daily operation of DFIR tooling, including endpoint detection and response, forensic acquisition and analysis platforms, and log/telemetry sources. Ensure incident response and forensic practices comply with RSG's information security policies, regulatory requirements, and national/international standards (*, NCA ECC, PDPL, ISO 27001, NIST SP 800-61). Manage the development and maintenance of the incident response plan, playbooks, severity classification, and escalation matrix. Ensure timely triage, containment, eradication, and recovery of security incidents, prioritized by business impact and closed within agreed service levels. Manage forensic evidence acquisition and handling, ensuring chain of custody, integrity verification, and defensible preservation. Oversee technical investigations of malware, intrusion, insider, and data exfiltration cases, including host, memory, network, identity, and cloud artifact analysis. Manage the quality and timeliness of incident reports, executive summaries, and post-incident reviews, tracking actionable findings and corrective actions. Oversee proactive threat hunting across endpoint, network, cloud, and identity telemetry, using threat intelligence and adversary techniques mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK. Ensure DFIR readiness through tabletop exercises, attack simulation, purple-team testing, and formal validation of response and recovery objectives. Manage the automation of investigation and response actions through orchestration playbooks and scripting. Ensure all DFIR processes, technical configurations, and standard operating procedures are documented, maintained, and communicated. Oversee the integration of cyber threat intelligence into detection, hunting, and response workflows. Oversee vendor and service-provider relationships for DFIR technologies and retained incident response services. Act as an escalation point for high-severity, sensitive, or legally significant incidents, validating risk and ensuring appropriate approvals and notifications. Managerial Responsibilities Provide input into the Department's cybersecurity strategy from the DFIR Section perspective. Develop Section objectives, KPIs, and annual operational plans for incident response, digital forensics, threat hunting, and investigation reporting. Contribute to budget preparation and monitor financial performance of DFIR-related initiatives. 5d70d691becbd665.description: About the Role Napco National is seeking a Warehouse Keeper to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. The role involves managing the flow of materials within the warehouse, ensuring accuracy in inventory, and coordinating with various departments. Key Responsibilities Receive Raw Materials (RM) and Other Raw Materials (ORM) via ERP Production transfers, verifying physical availability and storage locations. Coordinate with forklift drivers to arrange requested RM/ORM in designated areas after verifying availability. Weigh received and shipped waste, attaching documentation to packing slips and forwarding to procurement and accounting departments. Verify driver invoices against the updated shipping log to ensure accuracy and prevent discrepancies. Qualifications and Experience This position is exclusively for Saudi Nationals. A minimum of 0-1 years of relevant experience is required.
